statBlock.name: Cloud Giant
statBlock.description: Cloud giants watch the lands below from mountain citadels and palaces that drift through the sky. Some record what they see, while others meddle in the affairs of smaller folk.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks using Thunderous Mace and Thundercloud in any combination. The giant can replace one attack with casting Fog Cloud through Spellcasting.
Thunderous Mace. Melee attack, +12 to hit, reach 10 ft. On a hit, deal 21 (3d8 + 8) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) thunder damage.
Thundercloud. Ranged attack, +12 to hit, range 240 ft. On a hit, deal 18 (3d6 + 8) thunder damage and give the target the Incapacitated condition until the end of the target's next turn.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one listed spell using Charisma with a save DC of 15 and no Material components.
At will. Detect Magic, Fog Cloud, Light.
1/day each. Control Weather, Gaseous Form, Telekinesis.
sections.Bonus actions: Misty Step. Cast Misty Step using Charisma, the ability used for Spellcasting.

statBlock.name: Fire Giant
statBlock.description: Fire giants build fortress-forges near molten rock. Some arm armies for conquest, while others trade their metalwork and teach Giant forging techniques.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks using Flame Sword and Hammer Throw in any combination.
Flame Sword. Melee attack, +11 to hit, reach 10 ft. On a hit, deal 21 (4d6 + 7) slashing damage plus 10 (3d6) fire damage.
Hammer Throw. Ranged attack, +11 to hit, range 60/240 ft. On a hit, deal 23 (3d10 + 7) bludgeoning damage plus 4 (1d8) fire damage. Push the target up to 15 ft. straight away from the giant. The target has Disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes before the end of its next turn.

statBlock.name: Frost Giant
statBlock.description: Frost giants hunt and build strongholds in tundras and glacial mountains. Some raid for supplies, while others trade protection for goods from nearby Fey or fire giants.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks using Frost Axe and Great Bow in any combination.
Frost Axe. Melee attack, +9 to hit, reach 10 ft. On a hit, deal 19 (2d12 + 6) slashing damage plus 9 (2d8) cold damage.
Great Bow. Ranged attack, +9 to hit, range 150/600 ft. On a hit, deal 17 (2d10 + 6) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) cold damage and reduce the target's Speed by 10 ft. until the end of the target's next turn.
sections.Bonus actions: War Cry (recharge 5–6). The giant chooses itself or one creature that can see or hear it. That creature gains 16 (2d10 + 5) Temporary Hit Points and has Advantage on attack rolls until the start of the giant's next turn.

statBlock.name: Hill Giant
statBlock.description: Hill giants make weapons and tools from timber, stone, and hides. They guard the valleys that feed them, though an entertaining visitor might be invited to share a meal.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks using Tree Club and Trash Lob in any combination.
Tree Club. Melee attack, +8 to hit, reach 10 ft. On a hit, deal 18 (3d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage. A Large or smaller creature hit by the club falls Prone.
Trash Lob. Ranged attack, +8 to hit, range 60/240 ft. On a hit, deal 16 (2d10 + 5) bludgeoning damage and give the target the Poisoned condition until the end of the target's next turn.

statBlock.name: Stone Giant
statBlock.description: Stone giants blend into the rock of their caverns and canyons. They seldom intervene in their neighbors' affairs, but they defend their homes and places of ancient wonder.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks using Stone Club and Boulder in any combination.
Stone Club. Melee attack, +9 to hit, reach 15 ft. On a hit, deal 22 (3d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage.
Boulder. Ranged attack, +9 to hit, range 60/240 ft. On a hit, deal 15 (2d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage. A Large or smaller creature hit by the boulder falls Prone.
sections.Reactions: Deflect Missile (recharge 5–6). When a ranged attack roll hits the giant and deals bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage, reduce the damage the giant takes from that attack by 11 (1d10 + 6). If this reduces the damage to 0, the giant can choose one creature it sees within 60 ft. That creature makes a DC 17 Dexterity save, taking 11 (1d10 + 6) force damage on a failure.

statBlock.name: Storm Giant
statBlock.description: Storm giants watch for omens from palaces below the sea or castles in the clouds. When they intervene, they can bring storms down on their foes.

sections.Traits: Amphibious. The giant breathes air and water.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks using Storm Sword and Thunderbolt in any combination.
Storm Sword. Melee attack, +14 to hit, reach 10 ft. On a hit, deal 23 (4d6 + 9) slashing damage plus 13 (3d8) lightning damage.
Thunderbolt. Ranged attack, +14 to hit, range 500 ft. On a hit, deal 22 (2d12 + 9) lightning damage. The target is Blinded and Deafened until the start of the giant's next turn.
Lightning Storm (recharge 5–6). Pick a point the giant sees within 500 ft. Each creature in a Cylinder originating there, 10 ft. in radius and 40 ft. high, makes a DC 18 Dexterity save. It takes 55 (10d10) lightning damage on a failure or half on a success.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one listed spell using Wisdom with a save DC of 18 and no Material components.
At will. Detect Magic, Light.
1/day. Control Weather.

statBlock.name: Fomorian
statBlock.description: Fomorians retreated to the Underdark after their invasion of the Feywild ended in a curse. They turn that curse on others with Warping Hex.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Stone Club attacks. The fomorian can replace one attack with Warping Hex if it is available.
Stone Club. Melee attack, +9 to hit, reach 15 ft. On a hit, deal 24 (4d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage.
Warping Hex (recharge 4–6). Choose one creature the fomorian sees within 120 ft. The target makes a DC 16 Wisdom save. On a failure, it takes 21 (6d6) psychic damage and gains one level of Exhaustion. On a success, it takes half the damage.
sections.Fomorian Warping (1d4):
Choose or roll for a cosmetic effect of Warping Hex.
1. Bright blemishes travel across the skin.
2. The target sweats in shifting colors.
3. Tufts of hair move on their own.
4. Veins swell and twitch under the skin.
